note: Henderson County TN publishes no queryable zoning district service. The city of Lexington (county seat) publishes its official zoning map only as a static PDF (dated 09/17/2019), and its building page points to no GIS layer. Henderson County's GIS sources found are NC or paid downloads (Dynamo Spatial zoning fields are a paid quote-only parcel file; Equator is paid). No ArcGIS Online or Hub zoning layer exists for the county.
